CustomField.label: Ticket Price
CustomField.description: The price charged for this registration, copied from Event_Ticket_Type__c.Price__c at the point of registration by a Before Save Flow in Epic 4. Stored separately to preserve the historical price even if the ticket type price is later changed. History tracked.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The ticket price for this registration. Set automatically from the selected ticket type — do not edit manually.
